description: This file is a middleware implementation for a Next.js application that protects routes using Clerk authentication. It imports Clerk's middleware and authentication functions, defines a middleware that protects application routes while excluding public pages such as login, home, and static assets, and exports a Next.js configuration to specify route matching behavior.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Exports a middleware function that applies Clerk authentication to specified routes and protects them based on route matcher configuration.
